title: Week's best: Oral-B iO2 £35, Ninja DualZone XL £159 and Gucci Guilty Essence £48.99
description: This week's strongest UK deals: an Oral-B iO2 for £35 at Currys, the Ninja DualZone XL at £159 and big cuts on men's fragrance from £46.80.
intro:
**The pick of the week is the Oral-B iO2 electric toothbrush for £35 at Currys, about £23 less than Amazon was charging for it.** Currys' early Black Friday sale also has the Ninja DualZone XL air fryer at £159 and a Philips ceramic fan heater at £69. Fragrance is the other big story: several men's aftershaves are now around half price, which suits this week's beauty gift spotlight.

This week's roundup only includes deals we could re-check on sources dated 5 November, so some earlier picks are left out because we couldn't confirm they're still live. Most prices below come from Tom's Guide's Currys sale roundup and T3's fragrance deals blog. Buy now or wait? The toothbrush, fragrances and Christmas tree are worth buying now, as they're already at strong prices and stock of gift lines thins out. Bigger kitchen and tech buys can wait for Black Friday on 27 November, especially as Currys and Very both refund the difference if their prices drop.

deals.name: Oral-B iO2 electric toothbrush
deals.note: An entry-level iO with the quieter magnetic drive, for £35. Amazon had it at £58 on the same day, so this is a cheap way into the iO range. Our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/) has target prices for the pricier models.

deals.name: Ninja 6-in-1 DualZone XL Air Fryer (DZ901UK), 9.5L
deals.note: Two large drawers, big enough to cook for a family of four or five. It was £159.99 at Currys a week ago, so this looks like a steady sale price rather than a flash deal. See our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/) for the alternatives.

deals.name: De'Longhi Stilosa espresso machine
deals.note: A simple pump espresso machine with a steam wand for milky drinks. Currys has it at £99 in its sale, but Amazon is £9 cheaper. Our [coffee machine Black Friday guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/) covers bean-to-cup options.

deals.name: Philips portable smart ceramic tower fan heater
deals.note: A ceramic heater warms one room quickly, so you don't need to heat the whole house. It's best for a home office or a cold spare room. Remember that electric heaters cost more per hour than gas central heating.

deals.name: LEGO Botanicals Mini Orchid
deals.note: A small, quick build that sits on a desk or windowsill. At £15 it's a good adult stocking filler. More sets in our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Gucci Guilty Essence Pour Homme eau de toilette
deals.note: More than half off a newer take on Gucci Guilty. Under £50 makes it a safe present for a partner, dad or brother who already likes the original.

deals.name: BOSS Bottled Night eau de toilette
deals.note: A darker, woody version of BOSS Bottled that's more for evenings. Treat the £128 'was' price with caution because this scent is regularly discounted, but £54.99 is still a good price. Superdrug was also quoted at £51.

deals.name: Rabanne 1 Million Parfum 50ml
deals.note: 40% off the stronger parfum version of 1 Million, which lasts longer on the skin than the eau de toilette. A good choice if he already wears the original.

deals.name: Chanel Coco Mademoiselle eau de parfum 35ml
deals.note: Chanel rarely gets discounted, so 20% off is worth having, and John Lewis has the same cut on every size. Our [perfume gift set guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/) has more fragrance deals.

deals.name: The Very Collection 7ft Belvedere pre-lit multifunction Christmas tree
deals.note: £45 off a full-size tree with built-in lights. Popular artificial trees sell out by early December, and Very's Black Friday price promise covers you if it drops further. Our [Very Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/very-black-friday-2026/) explains how the promise works.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

For the fragrances, no. Half-price aftershave this early is about as good as it gets, and the best-known gift lines sell out before they get any cheaper. The Ninja air fryer and the De'Longhi Stilosa could dip a little further on 27 November, but neither is likely to fall much. If you buy at Currys before 24 November, its price guarantee means you can claim back the difference if it drops again. Our [Currys Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/currys-black-friday-2026/) has the details, and [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's sale dates.

## This week: Christmas beauty gift sets

Four of this week's picks are fragrances, in line with this week's spotlight, [Christmas beauty gift sets 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/christmas-beauty-gift-sets-2026/). It has target prices and the gift sets that sell out first.
